title: Memo: UK NHS data chief Ming Tang says Palantir-built Federated Data Platform is delivering "outstanding results" as she pushes deeper rollout of Palantir tech (Chris Smyth/Financial Times)
summary: Chris Smyth / Financial Times: Memo: UK NHS data chief Ming Tang says Palantir-built Federated Data Platform is delivering “outstanding results” as she pushes deeper rollout of Palantir tech — Ming Tang says the platform, which collates patient information in one place, is delivering ‘outstanding results’ in England
contentText:
Chris Smyth / Financial Times :

Memo: UK NHS data chief Ming Tang says Palantir-built Federated Data Platform is delivering “outstanding results” as she pushes deeper rollout of Palantir tech   —  Ming Tang says the platform, which collates patient information in one place, is delivering ‘outstanding results’ in England
